FIGURE 4.1. The Energy Balance Equation.
GOALS: CLARITY AND SACRIFICE
Clearly defining your goals is the first and most important step toward
achieving your desired outcome. You must have clarity in your goals.
Health, body composition, and performance are three distinct destinations,
and the more intensely you pursue one the higher the chances you’ll
sacrifice gains in the others. Many clients and athletes think they can
maximize all three, but unfortunately this is not the case. If you want to be
among the elite, you must make some sacrifices. For example, if
performance is your goal, you’ll likely—but not always—be moving further
